title: 1991 Score #417 Nolan Ryan Texas Rangers Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a rare and valuable Nolan Ryan 1991 Score Highlight 417 Texas Rangers MLB Card. As a baseball card collector, you understand the importance of owning a card like this. It features Nolan Ryan, a former Major League Baseball player and Texas Rangers team member, during his time with the team.

The card is made of high-quality card stock with a thickness of 20 Pt. It is an original and authentic card manufactured by Score in the United States. The card number is #417, and it is a single card from the 1991 Score set. As a fan of the Texas Rangers or Nolan Ryan, this card is a must-have for your collection.
